# Scene Real-Video Edit Records

This cumulative document contains three globally planned and locally verified branch edits for every completed Scene source video.

`instruction` contains only temporal placement, an explicit target, and one edit operation. Preservation requirements appear only in structured fields.

- Current range: `scene_001`-`scene_200`
- Source videos: 200
- Edit records: 600
- Branches: `E1: A_to_B`, `E2A: A_to_D`, `E2B: B_to_C`
